Suggestions are reviewed by maintainers. Filing this issue does **not** guarantee acceptance or create a roadmap commitment.

For major architectural or governance changes, read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) and follow the existing proposal process before a large PR.
